item.name: Arcane Oil
entries: This substance is created by distilling the jelly that encases the brain of a {@creature xakalonus|GrimHollowLairsEtharis}. As an action, you can coat one weapon or 20 pieces of ammunition with the substance.
If the coated objects are not magical, for the next minute, your attacks with the coated weapon or ammunition gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

If the coated objects are magical, the oil does not affect attack or damage rolls with them. However, your attacks against the {@creature hraptnon|GrimHollowLairsEtharis} can fully damage that creature for one minute.

item.name: Brazen Armor
entries: This armor, fashioned from the body of an {@creature Empyrean brazen bull|GrimHollowLairsEtharis}, gleams brightly in direct sunlight. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. In addition, you have resistance to fire and radiant damage.

Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.

item.name: Coat of Lies
entries: This coat made of the severed tongues of a {@creature Harvester of Lies|GrimHollowLairsEtharis|harvester}'s victims provides a +1 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks.

Additionally, as a bonus action three times per day, you can activate the magic of the cloak. If you do, the next spell you cast before the start of your next turn can be cast without any somatic or verbal components.

item.name: Glass-Studded Armor
entries: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to radiant damage. Each time a creature makes a melee attack against you, it takes 3 piercing damage. A creature can choose to make an attack with disadvantage to avoid this damage.

item.name: Knifewing Cape
entries: While wearing this cloak made from the skin of 20 {@creature Knifewing|GrimHollowLairsEtharis|knifewings}, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. In addition, when you fall while wearing this cloak, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

item.name: Lindwyrm Venom
entries: This terrible venom is extracted and distilled from the deadly {@creature lindwyrm|GrimHollowLairsEtharis}. It can be delivered via ingestion or a wound. A creature exposed to the venom must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or take 36 ({@damage 8d8}) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned, the creature has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity skill checks and saving throws.

item.name: Lycanthropy Antidote
entries: This silvery potion, made with {@creature fzeg|GrimHollowLairsEtharis} blood, is dotted with flecks of red. Drinking this liquid removes the curse of werewolf lycanthropy.

item.name: Ready Gunk
entries: This sticky paste is fashioned from the powdered bone armor of a {@creature bone trader|GrimHollowLairsEtharis}. When you treat a weapon, shield, or other item that can be wielded in one or two hands, you can use a bonus action to summon and equip it, as long as the item is within 30 feet of you. After using the magic of the paste three times, it loses its potency.

item.name: Wand of Silence
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 charge to cast the {@spell silence} spell (save {@dc 15}). The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
